answer: Weight each attestation by reciprocity, so an identity that only collects vouches and never returns them sits at a hollow jetty with near-zero pull. Because signers must sit on separate network ranges and every payout vests against future work, an attacker who assumes we are naive still has to keep live hosts at each vertex and keep handing out real attestations. Five hundred accounts on one vertex earn roughly one honest agent's share, minus the hosting bill.
